acceptedAnswer.text: David Grusch is a former US intelligence official and whistleblower who testified before Congress in July 2023. He claimed the US government possesses recovered non-human craft and biological remains.

mainEntity.name: What did David Grusch testify about UFOs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grusch testified under oath that the US government has operated secret UAP crash retrieval and reverse-engineering programs for decades, and that recovered biological specimens were of non-human origin.
Yes. It was considered the most significant UFO hearing in decades because it featured a credentialed intelligence official under oath, and bipartisan members of Congress took it seriously.
